name: MAINPORT Peer-Exchange Route-Servers
notes:
MAINPORT is a carrier-neutral connectivity platform based in Frankfurt, Germany. We operate a regional interconnection fabric across Digital Realty FRA11–FRA16 and Equinix FR5, providing access to Internet, IP-Transit, Cloud, and Internet Exchange services through a single physical port.

Connections are available via cross-connect or campus fabric within the listed data centers.

Key features:   
- Carrier-neutral & redundant backbone within Frankfurt   
- IP-Transit and IXP connectivity   
- 10 / 25 / 40 / 100 Gbit/s ports (LR / LR4 / BiDi)   
- 24 / 7 NOC and automated provisioning
